title: I want to play mobile games. Post it.
author: Need300dollars
selftext: Sometimes I overwhelm myself with making game so I want to relax and play a game and I only have my phone. Sincr I want to support AI games, I would love to check some mobile games made by this community. I won't play them all, though, it is as a pass time.

replies.author: Tall-Bicycle5298
replies.body:
Played it for a little bit. Its fun for a horde shooter. Pacing is nice. 

My complains though, the skill cards are too explainy. A damage up card shouldn't need to explain nothing changes on screen for a game like this unless its a +1 bullet. 

The skill "Cut and Run" should've probably just said -CC with an anecdote about special cases with the Kraken. I didnt get far enough yet to see how the effects are actually handled yet.

My nitpicks, I had to convince myself there was a guy singing sea shantys on my boat to get passed the vocals. Its not bad music. Just a touch different from the norm to include vocals during gameplay. 
(Theres only one in my game and its optional. The Playlist has a toggle. Only in there because of the person who does my music xD just wanted that out the way before anyone calls me a hypocrit)

My overall, its a decent take on a horde shooter. Ill probably figure to play it again soon.

replies.author: OneMoreCrew
replies.body: Yep good feedback thank you - the wordyness now you point it out is completely fair! Yer the music is a bit polarising I'd watched that Jason Segal movie where he writes the vampire puppet opera and I think my brain just went with that vibe 😅. I have got a toggle to change to standard procedural bit music in the settings but might make it a bit more obvious/ask the player at first load. Cheers mate!

comments.author: jildos_legoplanet
comments.body:
I’m working on a cosy tropical physics puzzle game: https://fishncrab-demo-v02.sidesliders.chatgpt.site/

There are 25 shells to collect 30+ animals to spot and working on the missions now. 2 of them are fully integrated.

Let me know your thoughts!

replies.author: SignificanceFun550
replies.body: surprisingly cute; pretty cool for a browser game

replies.author: jildos_legoplanet
replies.body: Ok thanks. What did you like and what can be improved?

replies.author: SignificanceFun550
replies.body:
the environments are gorgeous; that's my favorite part.

If I had to be critical I'd focus in these areas:

1) music is a tad cheezy  
2) I'd love to see organisms react when engaged or bumped into  
3) the crab field of view is pretty limited with no upward visibility which feels limiting after playing with the fish

Here's the most critical piece and I say it with care. It's not very fun yet. Finding 5 sparkling stones is more a chore than a fantastical journey as the game stands. I'm definitely not motivated to find all of them. I'd much rather agitate sea creatures or something with immediate known benefit. As it stands, its a beautiful exploration demo.

It's a great start.

replies.author: jildos_legoplanet
replies.body:
This is good feedback! 

1. The music is indeed to be improved  
2. This is a great idea! Will work on it  
3. The stones are being replaced by actual missions, did you try to interact with the sea turtle? That has the first mission. The plank on the sunken ship is the second. There will be 10 missions leading to a grand finale

replies.author: SignificanceFun550
replies.body:
I bumped into the sea turtle a few times.  I kept doing it because it looks pretty good!  But it didn't seem to react to me.

Happy to take a follow-up pass when you roll out some iterations.

comments.author: Cifoescoliose
comments.body:
[https://muralha-final.pages.dev/](https://muralha-final.pages.dev/)  
Designed for mobile: Defend your wall against enemies and bosses coming from the center, use the side routes to gather upgrades. Choose a special bonus for every boss you defeat. Unlock achievements and upgrades for you next expedition. Quick game with simple mechanics, but many strategies to try (still improving a lot of things, but already works pretty well as a simple mobile game to pass the time).
